name: HISTOIRES HORREUR - LARMES
source:
Throughout the chapters, discover new enigmatic characters through cold and gloomy places on the border between dreams and nightmares.

The being that exists between the real and the imaginary will always be there to make every story even more horrible. But what is its real purpose?

For the survival of several characters, choices will have to be made. Some of which can be painful. But be careful, it is already possible that it is already too late and that it will take you to the afterlife...

[Edited from [url=https://lessdessdouxstudio.itch.io/horror-stories-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
